title: Twilio reports Q3 revenue up 20% YoY to $1.56B, vs. $1.52B est., net income up 333% to $161M, and expects slower Q4 revenue growth; TWLO drops 15%+ after hours (Elias Schisgall/MarketWatch)
summary: Elias Schisgall / MarketWatch: Twilio reports Q3 revenue up 20% YoY to $1.56B, vs. $1.52B est., net income up 333% to $161M, and expects slower Q4 revenue growth; TWLO drops 15%+ after hours — Twilio lifted its full-year revenue growth outlook after the company reported a higher profit and revenue growth in the third quarter.
